tasks.description: Experiment 1, the varied-set procedure. A series of s = 1 to 6 different digits ([[param:set_sizes]]) appears one at a time at one locus, [[param:item_duration]] each, then a [[param:delay]] blank delay. A warning cross ([[param:warning_duration]]) precedes the test digit, which stays up until the subject presses [[param:positive_key]] (in the series) or [[param:negative_key]] (not), at most [[param:response_timeout]]. Reaction time runs from the test digit's onset. A green or red light ([[param:feedback_duration]]) reports correctness, then the subject types the series in order and presses Enter. The trial is scored on the yes/no answer; the recall is recorded separately.
notes: Paper values: 1.2 s per digit, 2.0 s delay, s = 1–6, 24 practice and 144 test trials (Science 153, p. 652).

ASSUMED (not in the paper): no gap between digits, the visual warning cross and its 500 ms, keys J/F for the two levers, the 5 s deadline, the 500 ms light, typed recall with a 30 s cap, the 1 s inter-trial interval, digit size and the disc 1 dva across 2.5 dva below the locus.
Deviation: two keys instead of two levers; the feedback lamp is an on-screen disc.
A recall that times out still ends the trial with CORRECT or WRONG; only a missing yes/no key is NO_RESPONSE.

tasks.description: Experiment 2, the fixed-set procedure. At the start of each part the positive set of 1, 2 or 4 digits is shown on screen until the subject presses SPACE. Each trial is then a warning cross ([[param:warning_duration]]), a test digit answered with [[param:positive_key]] or [[param:negative_key]] (at most [[param:response_timeout]]), and a green or red light ([[param:feedback_duration]]). Light, inter-trial interval ([[param:iti]]) and warning add up to the paper's [[param:response_to_next_probe]] from a response to the next test digit. Test digits are drawn from the paper's fixed 15-item population; each part has [[param:practice.n_per_condition]] and [[param:paradigm.n_per_condition]] copies of it (60 practice, 120 test trials).
notes: Paper values: positive sets of 1, 2, 4 digits; 3.7 s from a response to the next test digit; 60 practice and 120 test trials per part (pp. 652–653).

ASSUMED (not in the paper): the on-screen announcement read until SPACE, the split of 3.7 s into 0.5 s light + 2.7 s interval + 0.5 s warning, the visual warning cross, keys J/F, the 5 s deadline, part order random per session.
Deviation: keys instead of levers; on-screen disc instead of a lamp.
